description: Plan a Seattle visit day by day, the same plan as seatac.co/seattle-trip-planner: a work trip, seeing family, a game or concert, or a holiday (for a cruise use plan_cruise_trip). Give the dates; everything else is optional and can be added on later calls. Returns each day in order: arrival (flight, the Seatac ride with its pickup time and estimate), the hotel, each day's plan from morning to evening with meetings at their set times, meals, experiences and events, the estimated travel time between stops and a ride link for each leg, warnings when something won't fit, suggested restaurants and experiences for empty parts of the day, games and concerts on each date with ticket links, the ride back to the airport timed from the flight home, hotel options ranked for the trip (nearest the meetings for work), an estimated total, and plan_page_url, which opens exactly this plan for the traveler to change and book. Nothing is assumed booked. Read-only; no payment.

arrival_place.description: train_bus_ferry: where they arrive, e.g. King Street Station.

departure_time.description: Flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM. Sets the last day and the ride to the airport.

end.description: Day they leave, YYYY-MM-DD (same as start for a day trip). Or give nights.

home_airport.description: 3-letter code of the airport they fly from, e.g. ORD.

hotel_name.description: Or a hotel they booked elsewhere, "name, address".

hotel_slug.description: One of our hotels (slug from hotel_options).

landing_time.description: Landing time at Seatac, Seattle time HH:MM. Sets the airport pickup and the first afternoon.

meetings.description: Meetings or appointments at set times (up to 10).

address.description: Where it is, e.g. "Amazon Spheres, 2111 7th Ave, Seattle, WA".

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day of the trip.

lat.description: Optional latitude of the address, for travel times.

lng.description: Optional longitude of the address, for travel times.

name.description: What it is, e.g. Client meeting.

nights.description: Nights in Seattle instead of end (0-21, default 2).

picks.description: Things to put on the plan (up to 30): a pick_id from suggestions, events, find_things_to_do or find_restaurants, a date, and optionally the part of the day.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day of the trip.

part.description: morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner or evening (default: when it usually fits).

purpose.description: What the trip is for: business, visit, event or vacation. Business ranks hotels by the meetings and defaults to 1 traveler.

start.description: Day they arrive in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

suggestions.description: Suggest restaurants and experiences for empty parts of each day (default true).

name: plan_seattle_trip
title: Plan a Seattle trip
